data.situation: Patient of age not recorded presents with triage level RED, stating: Doctor sahib, there is severe pain in the chest, it is going to the left arm, and I am sweating a lot. It has been for half an hour.
data.background: Reported symptoms include chest pain, sweating, arm jaw pain, and severe pain with a duration of about 30 minutes. Mentioned red flags include سینے میں بہت درد ہے، بائیں بازو تک جا رہا ہے، اور بہت پسینہ آ رہا ہے۔
data.assessment: Meets triage criteria for possible heart attack due to chest pain + sweating + arm jaw pain, age unknown, and Severe pain due to severe pain reported.
data.recommendation: Referred to Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology with needs of cath lab. Medicines already prescribed: none.
